concepts.name: 余烬·断棘
concepts.detail: Scarlet red and crimson with tiny coral highlights. A brutal compact broad cleaver-scythe head: a massive wedge-shaped rectangular blade extending left of shaft then turning downward through a sharp squared shoulder into a LONG hooked tooth. Its concave inner edge has TWO deep angular notches producing THREE large inward-facing fangs, like a predator jaw opening toward the shaft. Outer blade back is a clean straight sloping line, NO stepped ridges on outer back, NO conventional smooth crescent, NO skeleton motif. One small rhombus negative-space aperture close to root, a low blocky collar and short thick rectangular rear counterweight. Squat six-sided hammer-shaped pommel. Shaft visually stout, angular collars clear of grips. Sparse short crimson lozenge sparks.
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original fantasy video-game weapon concept illustration for Skyrim mod Arcane Armory, second set of heteromorphic WAR SCYTHES. Create ONE imposing TWO-HANDED long-shaft scythe, complete head and pommel visible, portrait 1024x1536, dark charcoal studio backdrop, centered with generous 7 percent margin. Slight three-quarter side view to show solid thickness. Long substantial straight octagonal shaft with two comfortable uninterrupted grip zones. Head broadly extends sideways from top and ends in a pronounced downturned sickle cutting hook. Entire weapon is solid colored magical energy with flat saturated translucent-looking faces, thick bevels and restrained luminous edges; pure geometric construction, clean readable planes without decorative surface textures. No crystal cracks, no metal, wood, leather, gemstones, runic textures, stars, magic circles, characters, labels or watermark. Moderate localized glow, never wash out the silhouette. Simple physically joined geometry suitable for faithful 3D modeling. A few clearly visible small colored particles near head only; not a giant halo. concepts.name: 流萤·盘岚
concepts.detail: Jade green surfaces with turquoise and mint edges. A striking OPEN SPIRAL hook head: one thick blade ribbon emerges from shaft top, sweeps LEFT and UP, curves around a large empty off-center rounded-triangle aperture, then curls DOWN and INWARD ending in a vicious long inward horn pointing diagonally toward shaft. Blade shape follows a faceted logarithmic spiral, wide open mouth lower-right, broad band tapering to hooked point, just ONE ribbon, not paired crescent blades. Smooth straight haft connected on lower-right of spiral by a short triangular gusset. Small opposing upward horn at rear and open triangular pommel. Distinct coiled turbine-like silhouette but no mechanical cogs. Sparse jade comma-shaped curved energy chips.

concepts.name: 寒汐·折渊
concepts.detail: Deep blue planes with turquoise cyan edges. A highly architectural ZIGZAG SCYTHE: the blade emerges diagonally UP-LEFT from top hub as a broad straight beveled beam, folds sharply at a high elbow far left, and runs diagonally DOWN-LEFT into a VERY LONG tapered hooked cutting blade. A powerful asymmetric inverted checkmark silhouette with a hollow angular triangular brace underneath upper segment. One continuous monolithic cutting blade, no rectangular truss windows, no smooth crescent, no layered feathers. Head visibly tilted and higher on the left, wide sharp planar surfaces with small chamfers. Square straight haft and one long narrow trapezoid rear counterweight slanting down-right, flattened hexagonal pommel. Sparse cyan needle sparks aligned near long cutting edge.

concepts.name: 梦隙·环寂
concepts.detail: Royal violet and indigo faces with orchid lilac edge accents, NO red. An unusual VOID-RING SCYTHE: large thick flattened irregular HEXAGONAL blade ring sits entirely left of shaft top, enclosing one large empty polygonal center. Lower-right portion of ring is OPEN, and lower-left section extends DOWN as a dramatically long inward-curving cutting fang. Outer ring angular, very wide single blade band, obvious structural thickness. It resembles an incomplete sharp orbital ring functioning as a sickle, not a circular staff ornament. Ring's upper-right side connects firmly to a short OFFSET neck and straight shaft; a single small spear stub counterbalances to right. Shaft has chunky diamond collars and a forked two-prong pommel. No layered three-blade fan. Sparse small hollow lilac rhombus motes around ring edges.
